verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents distinct agents per workspace (one agent per workspace, each workspace exposed as its own OpenAI-compatible model) and custom agents that appear as selectable models. Channels let multiple models take part in shared timelines, which covers part of the routing requirement. However, per-agent system prompts and explicit rules for routing a conversation or channel to a specific agent are not documented. missing for 10: per-agent prompt configuration evidence, explicit channel/conversation-to-agent routing rules, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each

citations.quote: one worktree per task, one workspace per worktree, one agent per workspace, all supervised from a single browser tab.
The gateway exposes each of your workspaces as an OpenAI-compatible model, so any OpenAI-style client can run agent tasks in a real workspace.
Adds a custom model or agent | Appears as a selectable model in the chat sidebar
Channels let multiple users and multiple models interact in a single timeline.
